description:

- First Name: Elena
- Last Name: Rodriguez
- Email/User ID: elena.rodriguez@dev.arkcase.com
- Password: ArkAnalyst2024!

Assign the user to the 'ACM_INVESTIGATOR_DEV' group so she can investigate cases. Save the user and ensure she appears in the user list.
